name: WhatsApp
description: OpenClaw WhatsApp channel plugin for WhatsApp Web chats.

messageReceived.description: Opt in to broadcasting inbound WhatsApp message_received hook payloads to loaded plugins.

recommendedPrompts: Help me connect WhatsApp to this agent. Check the existing account state, explain the supported QR-linking flow and DM/group access policies, and ask which account and people should be allowed. Keep pairing material private and do not begin linking, widen access, or send a test message without approval.

Help me prepare a WhatsApp message for a contact or group I choose. Ask for the recipient, purpose, and any context I want included, check the destination against the connected account when available, and show the exact draft. Do not send it, add recipients, or start a call until I confirm.
